description: Runs one sebbi.pro compliance check by its id (from sebbi_find_checks, e.g. sebbi_euaiact_014). Framework checks take the deployment's governance or decision record as 'record'; agent-output gates take 'input_payload' and 'output_payload'. Returns PASS or FAIL with the reason and a tamper-evident SHA-256 receipt. Nothing is stored.

input_payload.description: What went into the AI step (agent-output gates).

output_payload.description: What the AI step produced (agent-output gates).

reason.description: Optional note on why the check is being run.

record.description: The governance or decision record (framework checks).

name: sebbi_run_check
title: Run one compliance check
